cases.name: Elizabeth Pena "Lisa" Moore
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Elizabeth Pena Moore, affectionately known as ‘Lisa’ by her loving family and ‘Liz’ by her friends, died tragically on Thursday, February 21, 2019. A beautiful soul who cared so much more for others before herself was born in Corpus Christi, Texas on a Saturday Valentine’s Day in 1959 to Luis Pena and Irene (Garza) Pena, and a family of five girls and one boy. Lisa loved white roses and to travel, go on cruises, being on the beach and was loved by all for her wonderfully silly, goofy upbeat and lighthearted personality. Always smiling she was a very strong educated women whom everyone wanted to be around. Known to be a great cook she never made anything that people didn’t find delicious and ask for more. It was her family, especially her children, that were everything to her. Lisa loved to sing and would often sing to her daughter ‘Ain’t no girl like the one I got”. She was simply an amazing mother, grandmother, great grandmother, Ita, sister, daughter and friend to countless many."
